finding: MOLLEO Task 3's entire oracle budget is only ~3x what pure chance needs to stumble on a handful of JNK3 actives
status: A PROPERTY OF THE BENCHMARK, independent of any policy or of COMPOSE.
measured_over: 80,000 random ZINC-250k molecules from banked random-zinc development runs, scored by the frozen Task 3 oracle bundle
implication: the whole 10,000-call budget buys roughly three chance encounters with a JNK3 active. The task is REACHABILITY-LIMITED rather than search-limited: the difficulty is entering the active basin at all, not choosing well among candidates once inside it. That is consistent with the QED lane reaching the same characterisation independently on a different task.
explains: why hypervolume on this task correlates 0.992 with best-JNK3-found
why Graph-GA is bimodal -- it either latches onto an active scaffold or never does
why Graph-GA does not reliably beat uniform random sampling (4/8 seeds)
why a surrogate trained on an official random-120 start is blind: it contains ~0.05 actives in expectation
correction_recorded: the figure this lane originally designed against was ~2% of draws. That is right for the ENRICHED pools left by earlier GA and adaptive runs and wrong by ~50x for a random-120 start. Measuring it rather than designing around the asserted value is what surfaced the error.
consequence_for_experiment_design: any experiment whose primary metric is a binary activity threshold needs thousands of calls per arm to have power. A 300-call rung cannot see the effect regardless of the policy under test.
